'''''Shandy's Pleasure Palace''''' was a [[Whaladon-class container ship|''Whaladon''-class container ship]] captained by [[Shandy Fanaso]]. It operated (briefly) as a portable [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], and was later seized by the [[Domains of Triton]].
